card.name: Partway through drug and enzyme names
card.fires_on: Pieces in the middle of drug or enzyme names, such as the 5 in CYP450, meth in methylene blue, or icas in fluticasone. It also fires on a few words like occur in interaction sentences.

modes.label: Inside drug names
modes.description: Middle pieces of long generic drug names before the name is finished.
